title: Unix password database content served in a response
description: The response body contains the root entry of /etc/passwd in its standard form: the `x` password placeholder, uid and gid zero, the home directory and a login shell. This is the canonical evidence that a path-traversal or a static-file mapping reached outside the web root.
remediation: Fix the traversal or the static mapping that served the file; do not only block the string. Move the web root so it cannot contain parent traversal into /etc, and audit the access log for the request that produced this response.
limitation: One response body. The check proves the file content was returned; it does not identify which parameter or configuration allowed it, and it does not read the file itself.

observation.body: Each line of /etc/passwd has seven colon-separated fields.
